card.fact_statement: Representatives from Jamaat-e-Islami attended a meeting convened by the Chief of Army Staff to discuss the creation of an interim government.
card.source_span: On 5 August, the Chief of Army Staff, Waker-uz-Zaman, convened a meeting with representatives from BNP, Jatiya Party (Ershad), and Jamaat-e-Islami and called for the creation of an interim government

target_qa_variants.question: 在2024年不合作运动期间，哪个政党的代表参加了由陆军参谋长召集的讨论建立临时政府的会议？
target_qa_variants.source_span: On 5 August, the Chief of Army Staff, Waker-uz-Zaman, convened a meeting with representatives from BNP, Jatiya Party (Ershad), and Jamaat-e-Islami and called for the creation of an interim government
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Jamaat-e-Islami is translated as 伊斯兰大会党.
